Not blocking: the rules file is personal-scope, reversible, and low-stakes, and per §56's <1-min diagnostic (see row 56) the miss is quickly recoverable once noticed because the ranked gap list is sitting right there in scrollback — this is a body-callout-tier gap, not a forcing-function one.
